descriptionHtml:
Antec AX65 ARGB Gaming Case + Atom B750 750W 80Plus Bronze PSU Bundle

Power up your next-generation gaming rig with high-capacity energy efficiency using the Antec AX65 ARGB Gaming Case combined with the Antec Atom B750 750W 80Plus Bronze Power Supply bundle. Available at Turbo Computer, this perfectly matched hardware peripheral pair is masterfully engineered for advanced PC builders, competitive esports gamers, and hardware enthusiasts across Egypt who demand high-tier GPU compatibility, coordinated dynamic illumination dynamics, and stable daily hardware performance. This bundle stands as the definitive choice for a heavy duty, future-proof desktop base upgrade layout configuration.

The Antec AX65 Mid-Tower features a high-airflow mesh front panel environment accompanied by a stunning 4mm tempered glass side panel to display your core build architecture. It comes fully equipped with four pre-installed 120mm ARGB fans (3 front, 1 rear) that can daisy-chain effortlessly for unified motherboard tracking management. Fueling this setup is the upgraded Antec Atom B750 power supply unit, delivering a continuous 750 watts of clean energy certified with an 80Plus Bronze efficiency rating. Outfitted with heavy-duty flat black cables and industrial-grade CircuitShield protection tracking systems (OVP, OPP, SCP, UVO), it ensures safe operation under maximum system loads.
